programme.desc: S06 E08 — Tailgate Surf-and-Turf Po'Boy Sandwiches Seafood takes center stage as Andrew fries shrimp, squid and small whole fish for Sicilian-style fritto misto, then layers crispy walleye and oysters into a fully dressed po'boy with savory beef gravy.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S03 E08 — Nashville Hot Pheasant and Mint Basil Lemonade Chef Andrew Zimmern takes a spin on Nashville-style hot fried chicken. Hot and spicy, batter coated, crispy fried pheasant is paired with a spinach salad topped with bacon vinaigrette and ice-cold mint basil lemonade.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S06 E09 — Game Day Chicago-Style Beef Sandwich Andrew builds a massive Chicago-style fried beef sandwich with peppers, onions and molten cheese before tackling true snout-to-tail cooking: a whole simmered cow head transformed into crispy tacos de cabeza with two salsas.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E04 — Grilled Rabbit with Panzanella Salad Andrew Zimmern breaks down a whole rabbit to grill with a spicy, Sichuan sauce and plate with panzanella.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E02 — Back to Our Caveman Roots Chef Andrew Zimmern goes primal with two antelope dishes: a Greek-style whole leg roasted over the open fire with a lemony avgolemono sauce and crispy potatoes, and a simple antelope tenderloin carpaccio served with roasted tomatoes and Parmesan.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S03 E05 — Creamy Clam Chowder and Mussels in Spicy Tomato Sauce Chef Andrew Zimmern demystifies cooking clams, mussels and oysters.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E06 — Grilled Eggplant Caponata Toast and Crispy Squab Katsu Andrew Zimmern creates an elegant, seared pigeon toast crowned with a Sicilian caponata bursting with grilled eggplant, olives, and capers and a crispy pigeon katsu served with a refreshing shaved cabbage salad and punchy ginger-carrot vinaigrette.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E02 — Poultry Perfection: Moroccan Spiced Guinea Hen with Charred Vegetables Andrew unlocks the rich flavor of guinea hen with a vibrant grilled salad featuring watercress and a mustard-hazelnut vinaigrette. Then, he slow-roasts a whole bird with Middle Eastern spices, served with harissa squash and eggplant-tahini purée.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E10 — Wild Boar Feast: Chorizo with Mussels and Whole Roasted Leg Wild boar takes center stage! Andrew makes chorizo with mussels, preserved lemon & white wine. Then, he slow-roasts a whole leg over fire, served Southern-style with pickled cherries, glazed onions & mustard sauce.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E06 — Minnesota's Foraged Mushroom Feast Andrew Zimmern explores Minnesota's forests for wild mushrooms. He creates a simple grilled mushroom salad, then hand-shapes cavatelli pasta tossed with golden chanterelles, butter, garlic, thyme, and colatura. He shares foraging and cleaning tips.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S06 E07 — The Wild Boar Playbook Andrew turns wild boar into the ultimate game-day spread with boar and black bean chili topped with crisp cornbread waffles, and pulled boar sliders braised low and slow in Carolina Gold mustard sauce.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S03 E04 — Bison Tomahawk Chop with Italian-style Eggplant and Panzanella Chef Andrew Zimmern shares a simple trick for getting the most out of bison tomahawk chops.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S06 E03 — The Most Underrated Game Bird Goose, one of Andrew's favorite game birds, is prepared two ways: a French onion soup-style grilled breast sandwich with caramelized onions and melted cheese, and a whole bird, cured, roasted on a beer can, and served with an apple-fennel salad.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E08 — Crispy Duck Noodle Soup Andrew Zimmern transforms wild duck into a simple grilled appetizer inspired by Japanese tataki and then uses the rest of the duck to make open fire duck noodle soup with fresh egg noodles, lots of aromatic herbs, bean sprouts and a squeeze of lime.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E04 — Mediterranean Grilled Filets and Salt Crusted Halibut Andrew Zimmern elevates California halibut, first with grilled fillets on saffron labneh with romesco and roasted cabbage. Then, he demonstrates a classic salt-crusted whole halibut, served with whole roasted cauliflower and a rich cream sauce.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S06 E10 — The Ultimate Elk Tailgate It's an elk tailgate over live fire. Andrew makes chorizo-spiced elk meatballs with queso fundido and red chile salsa, then cooks hay-smoked elk chops with charred alliums and black garlic-juniper butter.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E09 — Wild Seafood Risotto Chef Andrew Zimmern demystifies working with live sea urchin and scallops by creating a showstopping seafood risotto.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S03 E09 — Tuna 101: Grilled, Poached and Raw Chef Andrew Zimmern breaks down a whole tuna and serves it three ways: grilled, raw, and poached.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S03 E07 — Goat Curry with Rice Pilaf and Carmelized Onions Chef Andrew butchers a whole goat, using the leg and backstrap for a braised curry.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S06 E05 — Bison Brats & Grilled Kebabs on Flatbread Andrew butchers a whole bison leg before diving in to grinding meat for bison brats, grilling them up and topping with homemade spicy mustard. Then, he grills Middle Eastern-inspired kebabs to serve over flatbread for a feast built for sharing.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E05 — Yakitori-Style Skewers and Pheasant Flatbread Andrew butchers a whole pheasant to make yakitori-style skewers and a homemade flatbread, cucumber salad and a mango chutney.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S03 E10 — Hawaiian Plate Lunch Andrew Zimmern reimagines the Hawaiian plate lunch with a hand chopped venison burger topped with homemade gravy and a fried egg, jumbo grilled shrimp, a humble macaroni salad and a heaping scoop of white rice.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S03 E06 — Braised Pigeon with Homemade Herb Gnocchi Chef Andrew Zimmern cooks braised squab with olives and vinegar, a perfect meal for a fall evening.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S03 E02 — Carne Adovada Chef Andrew Zimmern prepares Carne Adovada.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S03 E01 — Grilled Turkey Legs, Creamed Greens and Lemon Orzo Chef Andrew Zimmern prepares Grilled Turkey Legs, Creamed Greens and Lemon Orzo.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E10 — Holy Mackerel! Andrew Zimmern champions the often-overlooked mackerel with a main salad of pickled filets, charred tomatoes, grilled frisée, and sweet summer peaches. Then, he grills it whole seasoned with caramelized onions, rutabaga mash and charred grapes.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E08 — Elk Tenderloin Tostadas and Grilled Rack of Ribs Andrew Zimmern highlights lean elk, first crafting classic Mexican tostadas with grilled tenderloin, avocado, and homemade salsa macha. Then, he grills a whole rack of elk, serving it with creamy colcannon, tarragon emulsion, and rosemary charcoal.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S03 E03 — A Whole Roasted Hog For pig roast perfection, Chef Andrew Zimmern marinates a whole hog.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E03 — Tailgate Tacos and Bison Bolognese Chef Andrew Zimmern starts simmering a classic Italian Bolognese sauce, with ground bison, lots of red wine and tomatoes. Then, he adds marinated bison skirt steak tacos with borracho beans to the tailgate menu.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S06 E02 — Grilled Yellowtail Collars & Filets with Miso Sauce Andrew cooks yellowtail two ways: grilled collars with a sweet, savory Filipino-inspired adobo sauce, and grilled filets with miso sauce, shiso butter, and charred vegetables. A lesson in using the whole fish and getting more from every cut.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E05 — The King of Open-Fire Paella Andrew Zimmern showcases quail two ways: classic Southern fried quail with lemon-basil aioli, and as an elevated topping for a traditional open-fire paella, complete with crispy socarrat. He proves this small bird makes an extraordinary dinner.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E09 — Southern Shrimp Skewers and Asian Crispy Rice Andrew Zimmern grills beloved shrimp in two distinct ways. He starts with jumbo shrimp and country ham skewers glazed with sweet-hot pepper jelly. Then, he creates Asian-inspired shrimp, served over crispy basmati rice and a complex sambal.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E01 — The Essence of Grill Culture Chef Andrew Zimmern makes two different dishes with red snapper: fried snapper fingers with a spicy chile-orange mayonnaise dipping sauce and a slow-roasted whole fish with a herb salad and charred miso sweet potatoes.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E07 — Striped Bass Crudo and Smoky Summer Succotash Chef Andrew Zimmern celebrates summer's bounty with an elegant bass crudo and a whole roasted striped bass topped with a herb-packed compound butter and served alongside a smoky corn succotash studded with charred poblanos.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S09 E08 — Super Sonoran Pati makes three classic Sonoran recipes: a fish special called pescado zarandeado, a rich stew called gallina pinta and a tasty dirty rice with clams. In Sonora, she visits vacation destination Puerto Peñasco.
programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: S09 E07 — Legends of the Sonoran Sea Pati travels to Sonora's coast on the Sea of Cortez, where local legend Toño Contreras gives her a tour including shellfish on the beach, his restaurant Mariscos El Rey, and his home kitchen for some crave-worthy recipes.
programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: S10 E02 — Food Meets Art Pati explores some unique spots in Guadalajara where food and art truly connect. In her kitchen, she makes pollo a la valentina, rice with poblanos and corn, and an almond tres leches cake.
programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: S09 E09 — Cooking for the Crew Pati prepares a true Sonoran feast for the crew - Sonora cheese soup, chicken in pecan and ancho chile sauce.
programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: S10 E05 — Jalisco Style Birria Pati experiences the Escaramuza — An all-female horse riding and skills competition. In the kitchen, Pati makes Jalisco-style birria and her friend, pastry chef and cookbook author Fany Gerson, joins her to make gelatinas for dessert.
programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: S10 E07 — Getting to the Roots Pati meets the young chefs behind one of Guadalajara's most exciting restaurants, Xokol. Back home, Pati invites her friend Francisco Migoya over to make conchas to go with pellizcadas with chicharrón in salsa verde.
programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: S10 E04 — Los Mariachis Pati learns about the history, the instruments, and the meaning behind Mariachi music. Pati makes carne en su jugo, tres chiles guacamole, and masa berry shortcake.
programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: S10 E01 — Welcome to Guadalajara Pati explores the culinary highlights of Jalisco's capital city, Guadalajara. She starts at a street cart to taste the city's most iconic sandwich, tortas ahogadas. Then, she meets one of the city's best chefs, Fabian Delgado.
programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: S09 E06 — Sonoran Family Favorites Pati spends a day in the kitchen with her middle son, Sami, cooking recipes inspired by her travels in Sonora that she knows he'll love - beef and potato chimichangas, rice with lentils and caramelized onions, and an avocado and radish salad.
programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: S10 E06 — Tradition and Innovation Pati meets chef and historian Maru Toledo who is working to preserve and pass on some of Jalisco's most important regional recipes. Pati makes Jalisco-style chicken tamales and chile relleno rice dressed with salsa roja.
programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: S09 E10 — Hacienda Ranch Food Pati makes traditional tamales with corn, chiles, and cheese, and then for the main course, pork chops topped with a pickled grape salad. In Sonora, she visits a traditional hacienda, where she gets a true taste of Sonoran ranch food.
programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: S10 E10 — Tacos and a Tostada Pati celebrates everyone's favorite Mexican creation, the taco. In her kitchen, Pati creates a pair of Jalisco-inspired tacos and a Ceviche tostada that are sure to satisfy any true taco-lover.
programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: S11 E07 — Cantina Culture and the Morning After? Cantinas have historically been bars where men gather to drink and sing about their broken hearts. Historian David Canales takes Pati to historic locations. Then she tries the best tacos in town.
programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: S12 E01 — The Nectar of the Mayan Gods Pati is in the magic town of Maní to learn about something sacred to the Mayans - bees and honey. A group of women who protect the endangered Melipona, a stingless bee native to Yucatán, invites her to join in a Mayan energy cleansing ritual.
programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: S11 E09 — A Day With Hugo Chef Hugo Guajardo researches the best of Nuevo León's ingredients. He and Pati visit a family-owned restaurant that has perfected the art of drying meat. Then, she tries his famed charred chicken.
programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: S11 E08 — Texas BBQ in the Orange Belt Pati visits BBQ champion Luis Rivas to taste his Mexican take on Texas-style BBQ, and he hosts a traditional carne asada at his family's orange grove. Then Pati learns how Glorias candies are made.
programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: S11 E05 — The Magic of Piloncillo The Garza family invites Pati to their vineyard to help the community make piloncillo - and it's hard work! Then, in the magic town of Bustamante, three sisters make traditional bread in adobe ovens.
programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: S11 E06 — Pioneering From Farm to Table Gaby Molinar owns Huerto Urbano, an urban farm dedicated to providing Monterrey with nutritious, diverse local ingredients. And her husband is one of the region's greatest culinary pioneers.
programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: S11 E02 — Sisters, Stew, and Sass Two sisters made a little shack on the Rio Ramos into a must-visit restaurant known for one dish: cortadillo stew. Down the road, another restaurant uses traditional stews in their famous empalmes.
programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: S11 E03 — The World Cup of Tacos Nuevo León is divided between two pro soccer teams: Los Tigres and Los Rayados. Pati tries the food at each stadium with the teams' stars to determine who wins in the battle of tortas vs tacos.
programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: S11 E01 — The Fire Kings Gualberto "Weber" Elizondo surprised his family when his grilling hobby turned him into a local celebrity and internet sensation. Meanwhile, chef Chuy Villareal of Cara De Vaca wants the world to know that the north of Mexico isn't just carne asada.
programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: S01 E04 — Not Your Nonna's Gnocchi and Meatballs In this episode Jamie takes midweek meals up a notch, knocking out a flavour-packed, simple gnocchi supper and giant spicy meatballs full of delicious time-saving cheats, and turns a family favourite on its head with his upside-down fish pie.
programme.title: Jamie Oliver's One-Pan Wonders

programme.desc: S01 E06 — Jamie's Outrageously Good Pulled Pork Jamie cooks two one-pan recipes that are ideal for busy lives: his take on shakshuka with asparagus, broccoli & harissa; and an outrageously good pulled pork that can be batched up, frozen and used in loads of meals whenever you're ready.
programme.title: Jamie Oliver's One-Pan Wonders

programme.desc: S01 E03 — Crispy Rolled Pork Belly and Risotto Jamie shares more fabulous one-pan dishes: foolproof tray-baked salmon in a bag; super-easy tomato fritters that you can rattle out in a frying pan; and roasted rolled pork and a risotto that are BOTH cooked in the same casserole pan. Result!

programme.desc: S01 E04 — The Chicken Episode Chef Dale kicks up the heat with his angry chicken, a spicy, spatchcocked and grilled whole chicken, and his kung pao chicken wings.
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S03 E07 — Top of the Line Steaks Chef Dale Talde is back to level up his steak game by grilling up a NY strip steak with roasted onions & poblanos, short ribs with chili paste and horseradish, and a grilled châteaubriand with charred Broccolini. Steak your claim on these dishes!
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S02 E01 — Apocalypse Burgers Chef Dale Talde kicks the summer off right with a burger blowout featuring Brisket Burgers with Grilled Onions and Blue Cheese, Shrimp Burgers with XO Sauce and a Fried Egg, and Lamb Sliders with Feta Ranch and don't forget the Lemon Oregano Fries.
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S02 E03 — Summer Surf 'n' Turf Chef Dale Talde kicks lobster & steak to the curb as he puts a Spanish-style spin on your typical surf 'n' turf by creating Pork & Clams, Lobster and Mushroom Fideos, and Tomato & Tuna Bread, then washing it all down with a tasty Michelada.
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S03 E08 — Grilled Chicken 3 Ways Chef Dale Talde amps up your chicken dishes by making smoky chicken wings, a whole roasted turmeric ginger chicken with tamarind sauce, and chicken patties grilled in banana leaves with chili lime noodles. A frosty lime rickey finishes it all off!
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S03 E09 — Scrumptious Summer Sandwiches Chef Dale Talde channels his inner sandwich lover by making an angry lobster club with pepper aioli and grilled bacon, a lamb birria torta with avocado and ramen consommé, and an Italian beef combo with chili crisp cheese sauce, giardiniera.
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S02 E06 — Grill These Sandwiches Mad Good Food Host Derrell Smith joins Chef Dale Talde at the grill as they cook up some stupendous sandwiches including a Salmon Pastrami Reuben, a Meatball Banh Mi, and even some Grilled Ice Cream Sandwiches.
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S03 E05 — Summer Seafood Smorgasbord Chef Dale Talde gets his beach vibes going with a grilled shrimp & lobster cocktail, clams with lemon breadcrumbs, a killer grilled king crab with burnt citrus butter, and a chilled mango frozen daiquiri. Don't you dare miss this beach party!
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S02 E07 — New Orleans-Style Shrimp & Oysters Chef Dale Talde brings us to the bayou as he creates a NOLA-inspired menu complete with Chargrilled Oysters, Black Pepper Shrimp Po'boys, finishes it off with Bananas Foster, and washes it all down with a Fruity Grilled Hurricane.
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S01 E08 — End of Summer Seafood Feast The end of summer is near, and Chef Dale makes a giant seafood feast; lobster, crab, clams, shrimp, and scallops, all served directly on the table with plenty of buttery garlic bread.
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S02 E04 — Perfectly Prepared Steaks Big Daddy Dale Talde shows you how to marinate, prep, & grill up the biggest and best steaks out there. From a Hanger Steak with Salsa Verde to a Ribeye with Ginger Chili Relish, and tops it all off with the father of all steaks… The Porterhouse.
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S02 E02 — Sausage Egg & Cheese All Day Long Chef Dale Talde brings out the best of brunch with sweet and savory hits such as Bacon Wrapped Dates Stuffed with Chorizo, Maple Sausage, Egg, & Cheese Fried Rice, and the tastiest BBQ Duck, Egg, & Corn Scallion Pancake Sandwiches you've ever eaten.
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S01 E05 — Brunch on the Grill Chef Dale greets the day with a Dutch baby pancake and tangerine syrup, crispy hash browns topped with crème fraîche and roe, and a ham steak smothered in sweet cherry mostarda and red eye gravy.
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S02 E05 — Pizza Party on the Grill It's Pizza Time! Chef Dale Talde grills up amazing pizzas for every palate including a Detroit Style Pie, a Cheddar Naan Pie with a Spiced Chick Peas & Potatoes, and gives your childhood favorite French Bread Pizza a much-needed upgrade.
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S01 E07 — Kabobs and Skewers Kabobs and skewers are a family tradition for Chef Dale; a Mediterranean-inspired meal features beef and shrimp kabobs with grilled tomatoes, potatoes, and eggplant, all served on warm pita with a tangy white sauce.
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S06 E01 — The Best Fish You're Not Eating Andrew takes on "little fish, big fish," cooking grilled whole small fish over Japanese charcoal with sesame spinach, and a larger fish in a bold puttanesca-style dish. programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S06 E04 — How to Cook a Whole Pig at Home Andrew tackles suckling pig with two recipes-his take on a three-cup braise with soy, rice wine, and sesame oil, served with plancha fried rice, and a whole pig roasted over open fire and pulled for Philly-style pork sandwiches with broccoli rabe.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S06 E06 — Game Day Fried Squab Andrew gives squab the game-day treatment with two bold recipes: crispy Buffalo-style fried squab with blue cheese and ranch, and red chile grilled squab taquitos with green tomatillo salsa, cotija and crema.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S03 E05 — Creamy Clam Chowder and Mussels in Spicy Tomato Sauce Chef Andrew Zimmern demystifies cooking clams, mussels and oysters.

programme.desc: S03 E07 — Goat Curry with Rice Pilaf and Carmelized Onions Chef Andrew butchers a whole goat, using the leg and backstrap for a braised curry.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S03 E08 — Nashville Hot Pheasant and Mint Basil Lemonade Chef Andrew Zimmern takes a spin on Nashville-style hot fried chicken. Hot and spicy, batter coated, crispy fried pheasant is paired with a spinach salad topped with bacon vinaigrette and ice-cold mint basil lemonade.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S03 E09 — Tuna 101: Grilled, Poached and Raw Chef Andrew Zimmern breaks down a whole tuna and serves it three ways: grilled, raw, and poached.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S03 E10 — Hawaiian Plate Lunch Andrew Zimmern reimagines the Hawaiian plate lunch with a hand chopped venison burger topped with homemade gravy and a fried egg, jumbo grilled shrimp, a humble macaroni salad and a heaping scoop of white rice.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E01 — The Essence of Grill Culture Chef Andrew Zimmern makes two different dishes with red snapper: fried snapper fingers with a spicy chile-orange mayonnaise dipping sauce and a slow-roasted whole fish with a herb salad and charred miso sweet potatoes.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E02 — Back to Our Caveman Roots Chef Andrew Zimmern goes primal with two antelope dishes: a Greek-style whole leg roasted over the open fire with a lemony avgolemono sauce and crispy potatoes, and a simple antelope tenderloin carpaccio served with roasted tomatoes and Parmesan.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E03 — Tailgate Tacos and Bison Bolognese Chef Andrew Zimmern starts simmering a classic Italian Bolognese sauce, with ground bison, lots of red wine and tomatoes. Then, he adds marinated bison skirt steak tacos with borracho beans to the tailgate menu.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E04 — Grilled Rabbit with Panzanella Salad Andrew Zimmern breaks down a whole rabbit to grill with a spicy, Sichuan sauce and plate with panzanella.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E05 — Yakitori-Style Skewers and Pheasant Flatbread Andrew butchers a whole pheasant to make yakitori-style skewers and a homemade flatbread, cucumber salad and a mango chutney.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E06 — Grilled Eggplant Caponata Toast and Crispy Squab Katsu Andrew Zimmern creates an elegant, seared pigeon toast crowned with a Sicilian caponata bursting with grilled eggplant, olives, and capers and a crispy pigeon katsu served with a refreshing shaved cabbage salad and punchy ginger-carrot vinaigrette.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E07 — Striped Bass Crudo and Smoky Summer Succotash Chef Andrew Zimmern celebrates summer's bounty with an elegant bass crudo and a whole roasted striped bass topped with a herb-packed compound butter and served alongside a smoky corn succotash studded with charred poblanos.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E08 — Crispy Duck Noodle Soup Andrew Zimmern transforms wild duck into a simple grilled appetizer inspired by Japanese tataki and then uses the rest of the duck to make open fire duck noodle soup with fresh egg noodles, lots of aromatic herbs, bean sprouts and a squeeze of lime.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E09 — Wild Seafood Risotto Chef Andrew Zimmern demystifies working with live sea urchin and scallops by creating a showstopping seafood risotto.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E10 — Holy Mackerel! Andrew Zimmern champions the often-overlooked mackerel with a main salad of pickled filets, charred tomatoes, grilled frisée, and sweet summer peaches. Then, he grills it whole seasoned with caramelized onions, rutabaga mash and charred grapes.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E01 — Grilled Squid Salad and Crispy Squid on the Plancha Andrew Zimmern creates a vibrant salad where grilled squid is served with shaved fennel, cherry tomatoes, endive, and a lemon dressing. Then, Andrew shares his country-style squid on the plancha with fresh breadcrumbs, chilies, and a homemade aioli.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E02 — Poultry Perfection: Moroccan Spiced Guinea Hen with Charred Vegetables Andrew unlocks the rich flavor of guinea hen with a vibrant grilled salad featuring watercress and a mustard-hazelnut vinaigrette. Then, he slow-roasts a whole bird with Middle Eastern spices, served with harissa squash and eggplant-tahini purée.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E04 — Mediterranean Grilled Filets and Salt Crusted Halibut Andrew Zimmern elevates California halibut, first with grilled fillets on saffron labneh with romesco and roasted cabbage. Then, he demonstrates a classic salt-crusted whole halibut, served with whole roasted cauliflower and a rich cream sauce.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E05 — The King of Open-Fire Paella Andrew Zimmern showcases quail two ways: classic Southern fried quail with lemon-basil aioli, and as an elevated topping for a traditional open-fire paella, complete with crispy socarrat. He proves this small bird makes an extraordinary dinner.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E06 — Minnesota's Foraged Mushroom Feast Andrew Zimmern explores Minnesota's forests for wild mushrooms. programme.title: Struggle Meals

programme.desc: S07 E09 — Chinese Take Out With the help of a friend, Frankie serves up easy and delicious recipes based on take out favorites everyone will enjoy at home. No need to shell out extra cash for delivery fees!
programme.title: Struggle Meals

programme.title: Struggle Meals

programme.desc: S08 E03 — Eat Your Greens Going green isn't just a trend; it's a no-brainer! When the veggies are in season and the prices are at their lowest, Frankie's colorful recipes and zero waste tips will have you celebrating the savings with fresh spring produce.
programme.title: Struggle Meals

programme.desc: S08 E06 — But First, Brunch Bring your loved ones together over a delicious brunch spread made with love. Whether you're celebrating a major milestone or simply toasting to the weekend, Frankie's money-saving menu will have guests buzzing for more.
programme.title: Struggle Meals

programme.desc: S07 E01 — Pizza My Heart On this special delivery episode of Struggle Meals, Frankie explores three ways to make delicious pizzas, and shares clever tips to make an A+ pie without dropping your dough on expensive ingredients.
programme.title: Struggle Meals

programme.desc: S08 E09 — Picnic Lunches It's field trip day, and Frankie shows off his best handheld lunches perfect for leisurely days at the park, the beach or the pool. These sturdy meals are made to travel and only get better with time.
programme.title: Struggle Meals

programme.desc: S08 E04 — Between Two Buns Is it a burger? Is it a sandwich? Could a burger actually be a sandwich? Not even Frankie knows the answer, but one thing is certain: whatever you want to call them, these fun twists and familiar flavor combos are super satisfying to scarf down.
programme.title: Struggle Meals

programme.desc: S08 E07 — Saved By The Bowl When you're craving a quick nutritious meal, say no more to throwing cash down the gutter for overpriced takeout bowls! Frankie recreates three restaurant favorites for a fraction of the cost, sparing your bank account without sacrificing flavor.
programme.title: Struggle Meals

programme.desc: S08 E05 — Struggle Splurge The key to treating yourself on a budget is to keep it simple: these elegant dinners taste like restaurant specials, but they can be prepared in under one hour - perfect for easy weeknight meals for a family of any size on a busy schedule.
programme.title: Struggle Meals

programme.title: Struggle Meals

programme.desc: S01 E04 — Comforting Mushroom Soup and Cheesy Soda Bread Jamie cooks a comforting mushroom soup with cheap air-fryer soda bread for under a fiver, stretches ham hocks into a second teardrop gnocchi meal, makes a low-cost air-fryer chicken burger takeaway clone, and bakes thrifty frozen-berry iced buns!
programme.title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals

programme.desc: S01 E02 — Better Than Takeout: Indian-Spiced Lentils Jamie makes frugal leftovers fun with spaghetti frittata, bakes air-fryer pork pies using affordable mince, and preps a batch of butternut squash dal. Plus, budget-friendly chicken shish kebabs and thrifty mint choc chip whoopie pies!
programme.title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals

programme.desc: S01 E01 — Not Your Nonna's Risotto Jamie makes a low-cost dosa, crispy chicken, oozy barley risotto, beef stew and shortbread biscuits.
programme.title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals

programme.desc: S01 E03 — Easy Stuffed Dumplings and British Fish & Chips Jamie saves money with easy stuffed leftover dumplings, a budget frozen-fish chip shop cheat, a store-cupboard jar blondie cake, pocket-pleasing pork tacos, and a brilliant air-fryer tinned pineapple tarte tatin dessert!
programme.title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals

programme.desc: S01 E06 — Easy Chicken Curry and Feta Tomato Pasta Jamie makes an air-fryer tomato and roast feta pasta using leftover noodles, a budget rolled carrot cake, and a cheap family chicken curry. Plus, an epic cheese-on-toast Welsh rarebit upgrade and frozen fish Chinese-inspired dough parcels!
programme.title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals

programme.desc: S01 E05 — Peperonata Eggs on Toast and Baked Cinnamon Apples Jamie makes a no-cook store-cupboard olive pasta sauce, a cheap frozen-pepper peperonata stew with coddled eggs, a wallet-friendly chicken thigh and bean roast dinner, and budget-clever homemade takeaway kebabs with flatbreads!
programme.title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals

programme.desc: S01 E05 — Silky Eggplant Noodles and Nostalgic Custard Tart Jamie makes an epic toad in the hole with onion gravy, silky aubergine noodles with peanuts and mint, a comforting and thrifty chicken, sausage & white bean bake with cabbage cake, and a nostalgic jam treacle tart with old-school custard.
programme.title: Jamie Oliver's Feasts for Less

programme.desc: S01 E02 — Caprese Chicken Burgers and Pork and Fennel Ragu From crispy, herby Caprese chicken burgers to golden spinach pies, creamy pork & fennel ragù with fresh pappardelle, and a comforting tinned peach cobbler with fruit-rippled cream, Jamie proves budget-friendly cooking can be utterly delicious.
programme.title: Jamie Oliver's Feasts for Less

programme.title: Jamie Oliver's Feasts for Less

programme.desc: S01 E03 — Homemade Bagels with Egg Salad and Cherry Chocolate Mousse Jamie's Thai red chicken & squash traybake uses clever tips to get more for your money, a sardine puttanesca proves budget doesn't mean basic, a bagel recipe creates a low-cost lunch and his cherry chocolate mousse is a little bit of low-cost luxury.
programme.title: Jamie Oliver's Feasts for Less

programme.desc: S01 E01 — Hearty Chicken Pot Pie and French Toast Crumpets with Bacon From a cosy chicken hotpot with braised cabbage to cheesy French-toast crumpets with smashed peas and bacon, a quick, aromatic fish curry, and a golden pear & almond cake with orange drizzle, Jamie proves simple ingredients really can shine.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals

programme.desc: S01 E02 — Better Than Takeout: Indian-Spiced Lentils Jamie makes frugal leftovers fun with spaghetti frittata, bakes air-fryer pork pies using affordable mince, and preps a batch of butternut squash dal. Plus, budget-friendly chicken shish kebabs and thrifty mint choc chip whoopie pies!
programme.title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals

programme.desc: S01 E01 — Not Your Nonna's Risotto Jamie makes a low-cost dosa, crispy chicken, oozy barley risotto, beef stew and shortbread biscuits.
programme.title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals

programme.desc: S01 E03 — Easy Stuffed Dumplings and British Fish & Chips Jamie saves money with easy stuffed leftover dumplings, a budget frozen-fish chip shop cheat, a store-cupboard jar blondie cake, pocket-pleasing pork tacos, and a brilliant air-fryer tinned pineapple tarte tatin dessert!
programme.title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals

programme.desc: S01 E06 — Easy Chicken Curry and Feta Tomato Pasta Jamie makes an air-fryer tomato and roast feta pasta using leftover noodles, a budget rolled carrot cake, and a cheap family chicken curry. programme.desc: S03 E06 — Braised Pigeon with Homemade Herb Gnocchi Chef Andrew Zimmern cooks braised squab with olives and vinegar, a perfect meal for a fall evening.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S03 E07 — Goat Curry with Rice Pilaf and Carmelized Onions Chef Andrew butchers a whole goat, using the leg and backstrap for a braised curry.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S03 E08 — Nashville Hot Pheasant and Mint Basil Lemonade Chef Andrew Zimmern takes a spin on Nashville-style hot fried chicken. Hot and spicy, batter coated, crispy fried pheasant is paired with a spinach salad topped with bacon vinaigrette and ice-cold mint basil lemonade.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S03 E09 — Tuna 101: Grilled, Poached and Raw Chef Andrew Zimmern breaks down a whole tuna and serves it three ways: grilled, raw, and poached.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S03 E10 — Hawaiian Plate Lunch Andrew Zimmern reimagines the Hawaiian plate lunch with a hand chopped venison burger topped with homemade gravy and a fried egg, jumbo grilled shrimp, a humble macaroni salad and a heaping scoop of white rice.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E02 — Back to Our Caveman Roots Chef Andrew Zimmern goes primal with two antelope dishes: a Greek-style whole leg roasted over the open fire with a lemony avgolemono sauce and crispy potatoes, and a simple antelope tenderloin carpaccio served with roasted tomatoes and Parmesan.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E03 — Tailgate Tacos and Bison Bolognese Chef Andrew Zimmern starts simmering a classic Italian Bolognese sauce, with ground bison, lots of red wine and tomatoes. Then, he adds marinated bison skirt steak tacos with borracho beans to the tailgate menu.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E04 — Grilled Rabbit with Panzanella Salad Andrew Zimmern breaks down a whole rabbit to grill with a spicy, Sichuan sauce and plate with panzanella.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E06 — Grilled Eggplant Caponata Toast and Crispy Squab Katsu Andrew Zimmern creates an elegant, seared pigeon toast crowned with a Sicilian caponata bursting with grilled eggplant, olives, and capers and a crispy pigeon katsu served with a refreshing shaved cabbage salad and punchy ginger-carrot vinaigrette.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E07 — Striped Bass Crudo and Smoky Summer Succotash Chef Andrew Zimmern celebrates summer's bounty with an elegant bass crudo and a whole roasted striped bass topped with a herb-packed compound butter and served alongside a smoky corn succotash studded with charred poblanos.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E09 — Wild Seafood Risotto Chef Andrew Zimmern demystifies working with live sea urchin and scallops by creating a showstopping seafood risotto.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E10 — Holy Mackerel! Andrew Zimmern champions the often-overlooked mackerel with a main salad of pickled filets, charred tomatoes, grilled frisée, and sweet summer peaches. Then, he grills it whole seasoned with caramelized onions, rutabaga mash and charred grapes.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: Podopieczni Merlina Polzina są w słabej dyspozycji - przegrali dwa mecze z rzędu. W poprzedniej kolejce ulegli na wyjeździe Eintrachtowi Frankfurt 1:3. W kolejnym spotkaniu Hamburger SV zmierzy się u siebie z ostatnią w tabeli Borussią Mönchengladbach. programme.desc: Podopieczni Merlina Polzina są w słabej dyspozycji - przegrali dwa mecze z rzędu. W poprzedniej kolejce ulegli na wyjeździe Eintrachtowi Frankfurt 1:3. W kolejnym spotkaniu Hamburger SV zmierzy się u siebie z ostatnią w tabeli Borussią Mönchengladbach. Gospodarze nie mogą jednak zlekceważyć przyjezdnych, zwłaszcza że ci punktowali w dwóch poprzednich meczach. Najpierw wygrali 3:2 z VfB Stuttgart, a następnie bezbramkowo zremisowali z SC Paderborn 07.

programme.desc: Historia Hamburgera SV, jednego z najbardziej utytułowanych klubów piłkarskich Bundesligi. Twórcy analizują m.in. sezon 2017/2018, kiedy popularne Dinozaury po raz pierwszy w swojej historii spadły z najwyższej klasy rozgrywkowej.
programme.title: Bundesliga Dino

programme.desc: Stefan Kuntz, Mario Basler, Fredi Bobic, Ulf Kirsten, Toni Polster i wielu innych zachwycało kibiców swoimi umiejętnościami na boiskach Bundesligi w latach 90. ubiegłego stulecia. W programie przyjrzymy się sylwetkom łowców bramek i oczywiście najpiękniejszym golom w ich bogatych kolekcjach.
programme.title: Najlepsi napastnicy Bundesligi lat 90

programme.desc: Filmowcy i dziennikarze zebrali w jednym miejscu ciekawostki dotyczące Bundesligi. Każdy znajdzie w tym filmie coś dla siebie, niemiecka liga bowiem to nie tylko sport, ale ogromne przedsięwzięcie dotykające różnych dziedzin życia takich jak ekonomia, socjologia moda i wiele innych.
programme.title: Birds of paradise

programme.desc: Trener Kosta Runjaić zapłacił posadą za słabe wyniki Udinese. Jego następcą został Javier Zanetti, który zadebiutuje w roli szkoleniowca Zebr w meczu przeciwko Venezii. Arancioneroverdi są jednymi z ich bezpośrednich rywali w walce o utrzymanie.
programme.title: Liga włoska - mecz: Venezia FC - Udinese Calcio

programme.desc: Marsylia po fatalnym początku sezonu i 4 porażkach w 5 meczach wstała z kolan. Ostatnie 4 kolejki to 4 zwycięstwa, dzięki czemu znalazła się 6. miejscu w Ligue 1. Nie ma jednak zamiaru się zatrzymywać i kolejny komplet punktów chce zdobyć w pojedynku z RC Lens. Zespół Michała Skórasia z kolei spróbuje się podnieść po przegranej 1:9 w Lidze Mistrzów.
programme.title: Liga francuska - mecz: RC Lens - Olympique Marsylia

programme.desc: Biografie najlepszych obrońców lat 90., którzy trwale zapisali się w historii niemieckiej ekstraklasy. Widzowie poznają życiorysy takich piłkarzy, jak: Mike Werner, Lothar Matthäus, Thomas Helmer, Matthias Sammer czy Jens Nowotny.
programme.title: Najlepsi obrońcy Bundesligi lat 90

programme.desc: Karl-Heinz Rummenigge Biografie postaci, które trwale zapisały się w historii niemieckiej Bundesligi. W programie m.in. wywiady z zasłużonymi piłkarzami oraz klubowymi działaczami. Widzowie zapoznają się także z wypowiedziami ekspertów piłkarskich.
programme.title: Legendy Bundesligi

programme.desc: Thomas Haessler, Christian Ziege, Mehmet Scholl, Stefan Effenberg, Andreas Moller... w latach 90. po boiskach niemieckiej Bundesligi biegało wielu świetnych pomocników. Piłkarze grający na tej pozycji walnie przyczynili się do sukcesów reprezentacji Niemiec w ostatniej dekadzie XX wieku.
programme.title: Najlepsi pomocnicy Bundesligi lat 90

programme.desc: Szybcy napastnicy mijający obrońców niczym slalomowe tyczki to nie tylko domena ligi hiszpańskiej. W historii Bundesligi także nie brakowało świetnie wyszkolonych technicznie snajperów, którzy bez wątpienia zasługiwali na miano czarodziejów dryblingu.
programme.title: Najlepsi dryblerzy Bundesligi

programme.desc: Atalanta od początku sezonu miała bić się o miejsca pozwalające na grę w Lidze Mistrzów. Jednak zamiast pierwszej czwórki bliżej jest strefy spadkowej, nad którą ma 4 oczka przewagi. Odskoczyć od niej i zmniejszyć stratę do czołówki spróbuje starciem z Monzą. Beniaminek zdobył w tej kampanii zaledwie 7 punktów i jest jednym z kandydatów do opuszczenia Serie A.

programme.title: Bright Now

programme.desc: S1 E43 — Planet X - Der verlorene Planet Ist es denkbar, dass es im Sonnensystem einen Planeten gibt, von dem man noch nichts weiß? Vielleicht gibt es sogar mehrere? Neue Erkenntnisse deuten darauf hin, dass es einen neunten Planeten, oder auch Planet X genannt, tatsächlich geben könnte.
programme.title: Breakthrough

programme.desc: S1 E21 — Auf den Spuren der Ausgestorbenen Wissenschaftler auf der Insel Svalbard suchen in fossilen Spuren nach neuen Erkenntnissen über die Erdgeschichte. Dabei gehen sie vor allen Dingen der Frage nach, wie lange es dauert, bis sich das Leben nach einem Massensterben wieder erholt.
programme.title: Breakthrough

programme.desc: Antes de la guerra, Alessandro Alton fue un alpinista que sólo tuvo una obsesión: coronar la llamada torre blanca, una altísima montaña, bellísima y monstruosa a un tiempo, de los Alpes suizos. Sin embargo, no lo consiguió y durante la expedición desapareció y fue dado por muerto. Después de la guerra, su hija Carla Alton (Alida Valli) organiza una escalada a la misma montaña en homenaje a su padre. Para ello cuenta con dos viejos amigos: Andreas (Oskar Homolka), un guía del pueblo y Nicholas Radcliffe (Cedric Hardwicke), un geólogo británico junto a un grupo de alpinistas aventureros de diferentes nacionalidades, que arriesgan sus vidas en el transcurso de una expedición a los Alpes Suizos.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Bounty Hunters

programme.desc: Rzuty karne w piłce nożnej to ogromne emocje towarzyszące zarówno biorącym w nich udział piłkarzom, jak i obserwującym je kibicom. Szczęście, nerwy ze stali i umiejętności techniczne są potrzebne, by dobrze wykonywać rzuty karne. Umiejętność ta jest bardzo ważna, bo strzały z jedenastu metrów rozstrzygały o losach niejednego ważnego spotkania.
programme.title: Dramatyczne rzuty karne

programme.desc: Trener Kosta Runjaić zapłacił posadą za słabe wyniki Udinese. Jego następcą został Javier Zanetti, który zadebiutuje w roli szkoleniowca Zebr w meczu przeciwko Venezii. Arancioneroverdi są jednymi z ich bezpośrednich rywali w walce o utrzymanie.
programme.title: Liga włoska - mecz: Venezia FC - Udinese Calcio

programme.desc: Stefan Kuntz, Mario Basler, Fredi Bobic, Ulf Kirsten, Toni Polster i wielu innych zachwycało kibiców swoimi umiejętnościami na boiskach Bundesligi w latach 90. ubiegłego stulecia. W programie przyjrzymy się sylwetkom łowców bramek i oczywiście najpiękniejszym golom w ich bogatych kolekcjach.
programme.title: Najlepsi napastnicy Bundesligi lat 90

programme.desc: Widzowie zobaczą historię jednego z najważniejszych zespołów niemieckiej piłki. Hamburger SV sześć razy zdobywał tytuł mistrza Niemiec. Aktualnie drużyna gra w 2. Bundeslidze i stara się wrócić do elity niemieckiej piłki klubowej.
programme.title: HHH - Hamburger SV

programme.desc: Michael Zorc, Stéphane Chapuisat, Robert Lewandowski, Andreas Moller to tylko niektórzy spośród piłkarzy Borussii Dortmund, którzy potrafili zdobywać bramki w zadziwiający sposób. W programie widzowie zobaczą najładniejsze gole w wykonaniu zawodników BVB.
programme.title: Najlepsze gole Borussii Dortmund

programme.desc: Filmowcy i dziennikarze zebrali w jednym miejscu ciekawostki dotyczące Bundesligi. Każdy znajdzie w tym filmie coś dla siebie, niemiecka liga bowiem to nie tylko sport, ale ogromne przedsięwzięcie dotykające różnych dziedzin życia takich jak ekonomia, socjologia moda i wiele innych.
programme.title: Birds of paradise

programme.desc: Barwy klubu FC Schalke 04 Gelsenkirchhen reprezentowało wielu klasowych snajperów, m.in. Klaus Fischer, Klaas-Jan Huntelaar, Ebbe Sand, Kevin Kuranyi. W programie widzowie zobaczą najlepsze gole w historii drużyny z Gelsenkirchen.
programme.title: Najlepsze gole Schalke 04
